Please read Good to know first.

GOOD TO KNOW

Chats go straight to agents: web chat, WhatsApp, SMS, Messenger and Instagram are now given to the next available agent with room, as email is, instead of an offer to accept in 20 seconds. A queue can keep the old way: Queues and skills → the queue → Chats and messages → Offer and wait for Accept.

Agents without console rights go to the desk: the console now needs its own right, which every standard role has except Agent. An account with only the Agent role goes straight to the agent desk. Custom roles that do more than agent work have been given it; check any custom role that should reach the console.

Bulk mail now reaches the Spam folder: newsletters and other bulk mail used to be dropped silently. With the new spam filter they are kept in Omnichannel → Spam, where they can be released, and are deleted after 30 days.

Queue announcements: flows that already announced the caller's place and wait now say "Your estimated wait is about…", and say "We'll be with you as soon as we can" when there is nothing to go on.

Not yet proven against the real provider: USSD through Grapevine (built from Grapevine's published guide; a few details need confirming with them) and moving a reseller to its own installation (tested between two test databases, not between two real servers).

Refresh browsers after the update.

FOR AGENTS

Transfer an email or chat: Transfer beside Finish hands a conversation to a colleague who can take it now, to a team or to a queue, with a note the customer never sees.

Chats arrive by themselves: a short chime, a desktop notice when the tab is hidden (allow it once with Desktop alerts in Chats), and the chat opens in Chats.

Shifts and leave: under Me, My shifts shows four weeks of shifts, with Swap, Offer up, open shifts to apply for and colleagues' offered shifts. Time off shows your balance and lets you apply for leave (full or half day), with a certificate where needed, and follow your requests.

The Academy: your organisation's own courses under From your organisation, exams on some courses, certificates with a PDF and an expiry date, points and badges for lessons and courses, and a learning streak that counts working days.

FOR SUPERVISORS

Waiting figures: callers waiting counts only people on the line; callbacks due have their own figure on the dashboard, wallboards, Floor and Live monitor. A queue that no agent can take, or that nobody signed in can take right now, is flagged on the queue page, the Floor and the dashboard.

Work nobody took: a chat or email every available agent missed goes round again after 30 seconds, and the Floor and Live monitor show it as waiting with no agent taking it.

Leave and shift requests: Workforce → Requests lists applications, swaps and leave with the team's cover for each day; approve or decline in bulk. Supervisors decide; team leaders see requests and cover. Post open shifts from the schedule.

Academy: team progress and certificates, another exam try for someone who ran out, and team learning challenges.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Your own courses: Team and quality → Academy → Our courses. Build courses from your knowledge articles, your own text, videos, PDFs and pictures, and your own questions, or start from a template (POPIA basics, call handling, complaint handling). Add an exam with a question bank, time limit and pass mark, and choose how long certificates last. Certificates can be checked by anyone at the verification address printed on them, and revoked with a reason.

Learning points: gamification → Learning sets the points for lessons (10), courses (50), exams (25) and high scores (20 more), or switches them off.

Spam filter: each mailbox scores incoming mail using what Microsoft 365, Mim"}
